decisions.reason: The necessary visual-cue impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY requiring visible instructional text inside the field.
The decision changes whether help text remains visibly present, not the Danish language or specified text of field labels and placeholders.
Retaining visible in-field help text does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
The source specifies visible empty-field guidance but does not necessarily change the selected field architecture or ordinary editable-text mechanism.
Persistent guidance when a field is empty does not necessarily alter the existing behavior that placeholder text clears when the field is actively selected for entry.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown method used to select dates.
The decision about visible in-field help text does not change the checklist and dropdown control configuration.
The source has no effect on required theme colors.
Field help text and control labels are distinct from image and table caption labels, whose typography and style name remain unchanged.
The source concerns interactive-field visibility and does not alter graphic bullet appearance or scaling.
The source does not change Enter-key bullet creation behavior.
The source's use of visibility concerns editable fields and has no effect on first-page number suppression.
